name: story-review
description: The story-review skill for Claude Code, which builds the review pages the Story Review VS Code extension opens.

plugins.name: story-review
plugins.description: Review a GitHub pull request as a story-order page: chapters in reading order, diffs rendered from git, walkthroughs beside the code, findings pinned to their lines with copy-as-PR-comment, and a file tree with Viewed boxes.
